description: One row per study and set: pre-allocation screening and eligibility records and revealed slots, from the reveal log (eligibility, bank_unavailable and reveal events). Counts only: no coded participant IDs, no list entry fields. Targets are not stored here (the dashboard takes them from the frozen sample-size decisions). Producer #33; consumers #35, #34. Unique key: study, set. CSV encoding and masking rules: analysis/docs/architecture.md and docs/interfaces/analysis.md.

bank_unavailable_n.description: Study B bank_unavailable records; null for Study A.

data_kind.description: Watermark: SYNTHETIC or REAL, equal to the data root's.

eligibility_records_n.description: Eligibility records in the reveal log.

last_event_date.description: UTC date of the latest reveal-log record.

planned_persons_n.description: Person slots of the main list units.

planned_units_n.description: Main list units: Study A batches, Study B dyad slots.

reveal_log_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the reveal log read (null: no reveal log yet).

revealed_units_n.description: Units with at least one revealed slot.

screening_cases_n.description: Pre-allocation screening cases (Study B: people who could not form a compatible pair); null until their source is agreed (Pending).

spares_used_n.description: Study B spare dyad slots revealed in place of a main slot; null for Study A.

title: Enrollment and reveals row (reconciled/enrollment.csv)
